name: smwgraphics-u-four-ia-the-saga-font
title: U-four-ia: The Saga - Font
description:
The font used in U-four-ia: The Saga, originally released in Japan as Hebereke.

Warning: This font has only uppercase!
Also, the # and the parenthesis are custom, the font originally didn't have them.

Update: Fixed the ' character, I forgot to move it up in YY-CHR and I didn't notice it at first!
